https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/infisical/35124:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.



We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.



Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.



About the role 

We’re looking for an exceptional Full Stack Engineer to help us build, optimize, and expand the foundation of the platform.

 

We’ve kept our hiring standards exceptionally high since we expect engineers to tackle a broad range of challenges on a day-to-day basis. Examples of past engineering initiatives include developing strategies for secret rotation and dynamic secrets, a gateway to provide secure access to private resources, protocols like EST https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/est and KMIP https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/kmip#kmip-integration, integrations for syncing secrets across cloud providers, and entire new product lines such as Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM.

 

You’ll be working closely with our CTO and the rest of the engineering team to:

 - Develop and maintain features whilst communicating directly with enterprise customers.

 - Expand our newer Infisical PKI https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/pki/overview, Infisical PAM https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/ssh, and Infisical KMS https://infisical.com/docs/documentation/platform/kms/overview product lines.

 - Experiment with novel approaches for applying AI to secrets management and more broadly security infrastructure.

 

Requirements

 - Deep technical mastery of the JavaScript ecosystem, particularly React.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

 - Exceptional attention to detail and eager to learn.

 - A bias toward action—able to make decisions with incomplete information, iterate quickly, and take calculated risks.

 - Based in the Americas (US or Canada), Brazil, India, UK, or EU. Must work US hours.

 

Nice to have 

 - Expertise in Go.

 - Has some understanding of devops/developer tools.

 - Previous founder or startup experience.

 - Previous experience building in open source or developer tools in either a professional or personal setting.

 - Excellent written and oral communication skills to interact with customers directly.

 

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

 

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page https://infisical.com/careers.
https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/uasi/jo:
Are you someone who enjoys turning complex data into clear, actionable insights? UASI is looking for a Healthcare Data and Reporting Analyst to support our service line leaders, management teams, and consultants through data analysis, reporting, and visualization. In this role, you’ll work with data from multiple sources to identify trends, build reports and dashboards, support client deliverables, and help our teams make informed business decisions.
The ideal candidate is highly analytical and naturally curious, someone who enjoys digging into data, identifying patterns and trends, spotting anomalies, and translating the numbers into meaningful insights. This role is less about building technical data infrastructure and more about understanding what the data is telling us and using it to support business and client decisions.
What You'll Do
Utilize Excel or other data collection sources to extract, clean, and join data subsets for in-depth analysis along with presentation of PivotTables and Pivot Charts for client reporting.
Extract data from multiple data sources for the use of identifying trends, analysis, and department impacts.
Create healthcare data visualization using graphs, charts, and tables to illustrate findings for use during client engagements.
Build and maintain recurring reports and dashboards (e.g., productivity, quality, turnaround time, denial trends)
Perform ad hoc analysis to answer business questions from leadership and operational teams
Identify data quality issues and work with relevant teams to resolve discrepancies
Support monthly/quarterly business reviews with data summaries and visualizations
Document data definitions, report logic, and process workflows for consistency and repeatability
Collaborate with IT/data engineering teams on data access, integrity, and other issues
Assist with tracking program metrics (e.g., recruiting initiatives, incentive programs, service-line performance)
Perform data validation checks on Code IQ to ensure there is no missing data, report outputs are consistent, all reports are generated appropriately, etc.
Support development of Code IQ revision for industry best practice data analytics and reporting capacity.
Assist with uploading and downloading project data via SFT utilizing the UASI protocols and ensuring accuracy.
Prepare Excel files for Tech Support to set up automated upload of cases to CodeIQ.
Assist with special projects as required
What We're Looking For
Associate's degree in a related field or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
1–2 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, or a related analytical role; healthcare experience is preferred.
Experience manipulating, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets.
Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including experience working with PivotTables, PivotCharts, formulas, and large datasets.
Ability to translate data into clear reports, visualizations, and actionable insights.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify inconsistencies or potential data-quality issues.
Ability to manage recurring reporting responsibilities while also responding to ad hoc requests and changing priorities.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across operational, technical, and leadership teams.
Why UASI?
At UASI, we believe investing in our people is key to our success. We offer a supportive, collaborative environment that encourages professional development and gives employees the opportunity to grow their skills while making a meaningful impact. We offer competitive pay and a full benefits package.
If you're analytical, curious, and enjoy digging into data to find the story behind the numbers, we'd love to hear from you!
